text: Sorry for the confusion. The test was only my own problem: I could not open the app in a browser, and now I can. Your goal is clear: people split Bible and other content as they go. For content with no template, they make folders and files freely, like a file explorer. Today they can split a Bible book, but only if they lead the team. Adding folders and stories exists only in a separate Manage screen, not where they translate. I will take back my old question about one Add a book button. It was too small for what you want. Next I will look at how to add and rename folders and stories right on the map, and I will send you a picture of that.

withdraw.why: Too narrow. Caleb wants free folders and files as people translate.
